old_design_retained.observer: Public-channel projection visible to an authenticated room member: room/game public snapshots and generic private round state, public text/roles/card ID, response state, choice/proposal revision, stream/revision/server-time/payload lengths; targeted private frames, actor-only HTTP responses, encrypted storage and raw edges are outside this probe. Membership limitations are explicit above.
old_design_retained.transcript_adapter: Production publicRound/gameView shape, solo primary recovered from rendered P1 name even if actors is empty. Consistent synthetic lifecycle policy supplies pending/active/terminal states, accepts/choice/finish and clock delays independent of secret class; declare generated metadata and distinguish real HTTP/WS tests. Include public text-role, card-histogram, generic counts by stage, lifecycle/revision/count/size features; never private card IDs.
old_design_retained.classifier: Diagonal LDA: train class1 mean minus class0 mean divided by pooled variance+1e-9, midpoint intercept, orientation fixed by train. Train pooled and per-stratum independently; no holdout orientation selection.
old_design_retained.auc: Mann-Whitney probability class1 score>class0 score, ties .5
old_design_retained.structural_blockers: Any explicit secret transport field or unique deterministic class decoder in compatible repertoire, state/timing/size/role metadata blocks regardless of pooled AUC. Inspect all declared cells; structural production-transport tests required separately.
old_design_retained.limitations: Fixed linear probes and approximate CIs do not establish universal privacy against arbitrary classifiers or participant conduct. No physical action performance is simulated or guaranteed. Actual private chat comes P05.
